## Owner decision

The owner's standing rule (17 Nov 2026, confirmed 23 Nov 2026): the fleet
orchestrator merges a PR without asking once its review ran (one Opus review,
two when trust is touched; one light review for docs, tests and tooling), every
high and medium finding is fixed, and "CI required" is green. No auto-merge.
The owner accepts the task in tm. Write here anything that still needs the
owner's own decision (a design choice, a DX eval run), or "none".
